answers.core: This change happens directly at the core on how the game export and referencing operates, it cannot be added as an asset library.
answers.workaround: With specifically developed third party tools ([example](https://github.com/donte5405/GODOG)), it certainly is possible to have source tree completely diminished. However, the duplicate `uid://` and `res://` will both exist.

title: Add an option to disable `res://` protocol and enforce the `uid://` completely
